# mxroute_reseller_packages (Data Source)

List reseller package names from one complete successful response. No per-package detail requests are made. Requires a plain reseller provider; impersonation aliases are rejected before any request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_reseller_packages" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (Set of String) Exact package names.
